args.title: Issue 4424: change src/exportUtils.ts
args.body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

The function formatExportFilename in src/exportUtils.ts formats the export file name with the ISO date from the provided Date object at.toISOString().slice(0, 10) which is in UTC. This causes exports done in the evening in some time zones to have the next day's date, explaining the issue raised where an export at 6 pm in Los Angeles uses the next day's date in the filename.

args.title: Issue 4429: change src/api/reports.ts
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

The duplicate report POST endpoint truncates the name using a truncate function with a max length of 120 characters, which leads to the ellipsis '...' when the original name is close to that limit. This causes the copied report name to end with '...' instead of '(copy)', making them look identical in the list, as described in the issue.

args.title: Issue 4431: change src/exportUtils.ts
args.body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

The formatExportFilename function in src/exportUtils.ts generates file names by slugifying the report name, which drops all non-Latin letters (including Greek and Cyrillic), causing exported files for reports named with those alphabets to lose their original letters. The slugify function used drops accents and non-Latin characters, explaining why non-Latin report names do not appear properly in export file names.
